name: archettu-manga-source
description: Personal manga sources for Suwatte, Venera and Tachimanga

scripts.check: npm run build:protocols && npm run check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:protocols && npm run build -w @archettu/suwatte-sources -w @archettu/venera-sources -w @archettu/tachimanga-sources && node scripts/build-site.cjs
scripts.serve:suwatte: npm run build:protocols && npm run serve -w @archettu/suwatte-sources
scripts.smoke:suwatte: npm run build:protocols && npm run smoke -w @archettu/suwatte-sources --
scripts.smoke:browse: npm run build:protocols && npm run smoke:browse -w @archettu/suwatte-sources --
scripts.smoke:venera: npm run build:protocols && npm run smoke -w @archettu/venera-sources --
